organization: Office of Veterans Advocacy, Boise (main office)
address: 444 W Fort St., Boise, ID 83702
hours: Monday to Friday, 8 a.m. to 4:30 p.m.; messages can be left 24 hours a day
source_title: Idaho Division of Veterans Services: Office of Veterans Advocacy
note: Office of Veterans Advocacy service officers are accredited and help with VA claims, pension, survivor benefits and appeals at no charge. There is no state residency requirement for help.

evidence.selection: Office address and phones as printed on the division’s Office of Veterans Advocacy page (last updated May 7, 2026); its Service Officers page (last updated May 15, 2026) gives the Boise line for the Mountain Home office. The division publishes no county assignments, so a county without an office shows the division’s statewide card. Bingham County’s veterans page (https://web.binghamid.gov/clerk/veterans.html) says most Idaho counties have a county veterans service officer, so that card also points to the courthouse.

evidence.selection: Office address and phones as printed on the division’s Office of Veterans Advocacy page (last updated May 7, 2026); its Service Officers page (last updated May 15, 2026) gives the Boise line for the Mountain Home office. The division publishes no county assignments, so a county without an office shows the division’s statewide card. Bingham County’s veterans page (https://web.binghamid.gov/clerk/veterans.html) says most Idaho counties have a county veterans service officer, so that card also points to the courthouse.
